governing_rule: Do not merge stale or overlapping PRs wholesale. Rebuild or extract unique validated deltas on current main, preserve current controls, rerun current validation and close or supersede explicitly.

state_meanings.REBUILD_ON_CURRENT_MAIN: Substantive delta remains valuable but the active implementation must be rebuilt from fresh main and current controls.
state_meanings.EXTRACT_UNIQUE_DELTA: Preserve only the still-unique source, correction, data or validator delta; do not merge the stale package wholesale.
state_meanings.READY_AFTER_REBASE: Narrow technical change may proceed only after current-main rebase, compatibility checks and current CI.
state_meanings.HOLD_PENDING_EVIDENCE: Do not publish or merge until the identified source/authentication/custody gap is closed or the scope is reduced safely.
state_meanings.HOLD_PENDING_AUTHORITY: Do not merge without fresh purpose-specific authority and current legal/privacy/publication review.
state_meanings.VERIFICATION_ONLY: Read-only verifier or closeout control; merge only if the verifier remains unique and compatible with the present verification architecture.
state_meanings.SUPERSEDED: A later merged/current implementation controls; retain this PR only as history/provenance.
state_meanings.CLOSE_NO_UNIQUE_DELTA: Current main already contains stronger or later controls and no unique delta is expected; verify once, then close with a supersession note.
